api_corrections: Removed the redundant EPHandle.recv_count_is_exact field and constructor argument; count availability is derived internally from the CPU per-expert counts. ElasticBuffer.combine: bias and previous_event are Optional to match their None defaults. ElasticBuffer.__init__: removed the num_bytes override; sizing is automatic and requires positive num_max_tokens_per_rank and hidden constructor arguments. Removed the num_nixl_channels override; transport channels are configured internally. Removed public metadata getters, publish, and connect_ranks metadata arguments; connect_ranks uses a Store with the NIXL_EP key prefix. ElasticBuffer.__init__: requires world_rank and both maximum-world dimensions; removed process-group/cohort, explicit-coordinate, bootstrap_id and store_timeout_secs arguments. Construction initializes only the local rank with no connected peers; Store access belongs to connect_ranks. Removed bootstrap_id from get_buffer_size_hint. Removed the public get_logical_domain_size helper; domain discovery belongs to test setup. ElasticBuffer.get_buffer_size_hint: requires both maximum-world dimensions and sizes locally; removed group, num_group_scaleup_ranks, store and store_timeout_secs. set_active_ranks validates and activates membership in one call, without saved pending topology. Topology inspection and coordinate helpers are private; disconnect_ranks validates the entire retirement request before mutation and, on an active local rank, excludes requested peers from membership in the same call; survivors must form a nonempty product of domains and positions. Direct/hybrid mode follows the surviving world and the fixed SM count is unchanged. An inactive local rank preserves its active-world descriptor while retiring any connected peers, including all peers in that world. Invalid requests and non-product survivors preserve both membership and connections; an empty request is a no-op. Callers still drain the old world and rendezvous before retirement; the call does not coordinate ranks. These semantic corrections leave public signatures unchanged. Removed redundant is_active; membership is available through get_active_ranks. Public expert IDs use world_rank * num_experts_per_rank + local_expert_idx across the declared maximum world and remain fixed across extent changes; production dispatch drops inactive-rank selections. Internal source metadata retains committed-extent rank encoding. This semantic correction leaves public signatures unchanged; the shell does not simulate routing. Dispatch/combine support a single active rank before peer connection; inactive ranks remain rejected. ElasticBuffer.__init__: num_experts_per_rank is a required keyword-only positive integer specifying fixed physical slot capacity; unused slots remain valid and barrier-only buffers are unsupported. ElasticBuffer.__init__: keyword-only num_launch_sms=24 selects an even per-buffer main dispatch/combine block count from 2 through 64, exposed by a read-only property and fixed for the buffer lifetime, including captured graph replays. Membership and direct/hybrid mode can change while reusing the same graph. Removed dispatch num_sms and set_active_ranks num_active_sms arguments, set_num_active_sms, get_theoretical_num_sms, all automatic selection state, and the EPHandle.num_sms field and constructor argument.
